Attorney General Pam Bondi’s [contentious House
hearing](https://www.axios.com/2026/02/11/pam-bondi-hearing-congress-
democrats-epstein) about the Justice Department’s handling of the Epstein
files offered a clear message to the nation: sex trafficking of women and
minors is perfectly acceptable as long as wealthy white men do it.

[Jeffrey Epstein](https://jmail.world/), the disgraced late sex trafficker,
fixer, and political networker, was found to have ties to huge number of the
world’s elites on both sides of the political aisle — including Elon Musk,
Peter Thiel, Ehud Barak, Bill Gates, Steve Bannon, Larry Summers, Bill
Clinton, and of course, Donald Trump.

For years, Trump’s conservative backers have attacked
[LGBTQ+](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/chabria-maga-launches-another-
save-110000474.html) [people](https://www.aclu.org/podcast/protecting-women-
and-children-is-a-shield-for-transphobia), [drag
queens,](https://www.forbes.com/sites/conormurray/2023/02/03/how-drag-queens-
became-a-right-wing-target-from-alex-jones-to-tucker-carlsonwith-these-states-
trying-to-ban-story-hours-and-shows/)
[immigrants](https://www.politico.com/news/2024/10/12/trump-racist-rhetoric-
immigrants-00183537), and others, claiming a desire to protect women and
children from rapists and groomers. Trump even
[boasted](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-protecting-women-whether-they-
like-it-or-not-wisconsin/) that “whether the women liked it or not,” he would
“protect” them from migrants, whom he slandered as “monsters” who “kidnap and
kill our children.”

But when given the opportunity to seek justice for countless women and
children who were trafficked, abused, and exploited by the world’s wealthiest,
most powerful people, the MAGA movement and its leaders have shown a startling
disinterest in accountability. During her hearing Bondi tried desperately to
deflect attention, [claiming](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/11/trump-pam-bondi-
hearing-stock-epstein-judiciary-dow.html) that the stock market was more
deserving of public attention than Epstein’s victims.

Even the Republican rank and file is now mysteriously detached from the
Epstein files.

[Polls](https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/10/politics/republicans-epstein-shift-
polls) show that in summer 2025, 40 percent of GOP voters disapproved of the
federal government’s handling of the Epstein files. But by January 2026, only
about half that percentage disapproved — even after the Trump administration
[missed](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jan/19/jeffrey-epstein-
files-unreleased-trump-doj) its deadline to release millions of files and then
released them in a way that [exposed the
victims](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/government-says-its-fixing-
thousands-of-documents-in-epstein-related-files-that-may-have-had-victim-
information) while [protecting](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/massie-khanna-
epstein-files-6-men/) the perpetrators.

While some [European
leaders](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/02/06/epstein-europe-america-
fallout-00769506?cid=apn) are facing harsh consequences for associating with
Epstein, [no Americans
outside](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/02/01/epstein-files-todd-blanche-
photos-00759045) of Epstein and his closest associate Ghislaine Maxwell have
faced any consequences, legal or otherwise.

That’s despite very concrete ties between the Trump administration and the sex
trafficker. Not only did Trump’s Commerce Secretary [Howard
Lutnick](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-news/howard-lutnick-
admits-jeffrey-epstein-island-1235514372/) admit to visiting Epstein island
after lying about it (and has so far faced no consequences), but Trump himself
is [named more than a million times](https://truthout.org/articles/raskin-
trump-mentioned-more-than-a-million-times-in-unredacted-epstein-files/) in the
files, according to lawmakers with access to the unredacted documents. Several
victims identify Trump by name, [alleging he raped and assaulted
them](https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%2010/EFTA01660679.pdf).

And it’s not just Trump. Epstein was an equal opportunity fixer. He was just
as friendly with liberals as he was with conservatives, including Summers,
Clinton, and, disconcertingly for the American left, [Noam
Chomsky](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/feb/08/noam-chomsky-epstein-
ties-wife-apology). For elites like Epstein, ideological differences were
superficial. The real distinction was money, power, and connections.

Epstein was a glorified drug dealer and his drugs of choice were the
vulnerable bodies of women and children, offered up to his friends and allies
as the forbidden currency he traded in. A useful moniker has emerged to
describe the global network of elites whose power and privilege continues to
protect them from accountability: the Epstein Class.

Georgia Senator [John Ossoff](https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/09/politics/epstein-
